rows.description: A preschooler learns to hush in prayer, a moment of silence or nap time. Staying quiet with others is a skill of self-control, and a child may need gentle help when a long silence feels hard.

rows.description: A young child watches puja, aarti, birthday songs or a candle blown out and learns that certain actions mark special moments. Explaining why the ritual matters helps meaning grow beyond imitation.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A young child draws hearts, says I love you or shares a favourite thing with family. Love shows through repeated small acts, and words may run ahead of understanding.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A preschooler strokes a baby's head or tucks in a toy gently, feeling soft protective care. Tenderness is learned through being cared for and is shown in gentle touch and quiet voice.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A preschooler waves at the door, offers a seat or invites a new child to play. Welcoming teaches inclusion, and adults can model it with greetings such as namaste or hello.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A preschooler sulks, drops their shoulders or protests when a plan is cancelled or a prize is lost. Naming the disappointment and allowing it to pass teaches that letdowns are survivable.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A young child seems quiet and clingy after losing a pet or a move, showing sorrow in play, drawings or questions. Short honest explanations and routine help more than long talks.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A preschooler shrieks or runs to an adult when startled by a bang or a sudden change. Alarm needs quick reassurance, and a calm adult helps the child judge real from imagined danger.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: anger, surprise, calm

rows.description: A young child growls, kicks a block tower or gives up when a task is too hard. Praising effort and breaking the task into steps keeps frustration from becoming quitting.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A preschooler whines, scowls or pushes a sibling away when tired or crowded. Irritation is often about hunger, sleep or noise, so meeting the need can settle it.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
